% caption (Title Case): \caption{Liberalism of \emph{La Libertad Avanza}, Scored and Predicted}
\par\smallskip\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\textit{Notes:} Horizontal axis: liberalism predicted by column (5) of Tables 4--8 (populism, ideology and their interaction; country and year fixed effects; estimated on the baseline manifestos), that is the liberalism of an Argentine party with the same populism and ideology scores in the same election year. Vertical axis: the scored liberalism (0--10). Points above the dashed 45-degree line are more liberal than predicted. Red diamonds: the 5 platforms of La Libertad Avanza 2021--2025; blue dots: the 25 other Argentine platforms 2021--2025 with populism and ideology scores; all filed with the C\'amara Nacional Electoral and scored out of sample with the identical pipeline and aggregation rule as the baseline (CF = Capital Federal, BA = Buenos Aires province; 2023 = national platform, filed for the primaries (PASO) and the general election).\end{minipage}
